tasks.title: E13 in full from its design
tasks.brief: You are the only coder on epic E13 (Local reasoning and assessment). Implement it in full from its design docs/tdd/E13.md: every section, and every R, V and D of its acceptance matrix with a test, including end to end tests on the real stack. docs/build/E13/PLAN.md and ticket_tasks in docs/build/E13/tasks.json describe one split of this work with briefs, tests and gates: use them as a guide and checklist; the design and docs/SYSTEM.md win where they differ. Build in this order: domain, application, adapters, api, user interface, and run your tests as you go. If an epic you depend on has no code yet, code against its port protocol and the kernel fakes (docs/SYSTEM.md section 10).

This brief is standalone; PLAN.md supplies the explicit deviations and coordinator handoffs C1 to C8. Frozen docs/tdd/E13.md is not editable. Work only in owned_paths. All implementation paths are absent at planning time; recheck existence and every docs/build/*/tasks.json before creating anything. Do not edit contracts, configuration, generated models, provider implementations, shared manifests, the shell, fixtures, AI-USE-LOG.md or another task's files. E13 request/review files are absent: request coordinator filing/review under C8, never assume embedded design requests were accepted. Missing shared signatures or ownership are dispatch holds, not permission to invent them. Do not create extra initializers outside your inventory.

Use SYSTEM 5.1 IdFactory/require_id; 5.2 Clock, TimeInput, corrections and process_epoch; 5.3 MissionClock with opaque versions; 5.4 Decimal Quantity/Unit with UCUM and nonfinite rejection; 5.5 ProblemError/StorageUnavailable and generated ErrorEnvelope; 5.6 ConfigReleaseReader/ConfigReader/ReleaseHandle, ReleaseCheck/LoaderCheckRegistry and TemplateRenderer; 5.7 UnitOfWork/ReadSnapshot, factories, StorageSession, domain bus, OutboxEvent and mandatory Audience/LocalProjectionRegistration; 5.8 command_identity/CommandIdentity, IdempotencyStore, AcceptedReceipt, CommandIntents and current ResultVisibility; 5.9 AuditEntry and shared hash chain; 5.10 Scheduler elapsed/absolute deadlines; 5.10.1 TaskInput/TaskLease/TaskResult/TaskStatus, TaskQueue, TaskRunner and TaskHandler; 5.11 HubSettings/SettingSpec; 5.12 ModuleRegistry/create_app(settings). Never implement replacements, manual commits, retry loops, feature task queues or clocks. SYSTEM 6.2 supplies standalone uv --project hub and its pytest config; 6.4 generated import contracts and application-port-only seams; 6.5 generated base/effective models. SYSTEM 8.1 resolves seams, 8.2 supplies required GuidanceEligibility, 8.3 requires current object/field/purpose grants and 8.6 governs durability. D7 puts operational ceilings in settings, intersected with any stricter existing policy cap. No literal fallback settings or missing-content defaults.

SYSTEM 9 makes E01/E02/E11/E12/E27-guidance hard. SYSTEM 10 supplies bounded kernel.testing fakes at published ports for component tests; require them and generated contracts before coding. No provider code exists now. Missing optional providers yield documented unavailable/unknown behavior, never a production fake. Pending provider DTOs and task bindings in C1 to C7 block dependent work. No module imports another module's domain/adapters/api. Current E10/E11/E12/E18/E26 interfaces supersede the incompatible E13 sketches as explained below. A component fake cannot close a real seam or pass a positive acceptance scenario.

Tests first, trace each to its assigned T-E13 ID and R/V/D/invariant; E13 section 12 defines those IDs. Use configured fixtures through real validation and explicit SIM/REPLAY/demo profiles; test data only under fixtures/ or eval/. Ask E21 for missing scripts, never embed clinical sample strings or implement another stub. Use independent source-checked golden support/safety expectations, not just the document under test. Test null/empty/zero/negative/maximum, changed values/units, all origins and unknown/declined data. Every module needs a non-safety content-edit test with no code edit. Inject clocks and identifiers; component tests have no network/devices/wall clock.

AGENTS 6 applies: crash/power loss at command boundaries, duplicate/retried/changed-target commands, concurrent clients, disk full, corrupt/missing config and last good release, forward/backward clock corrections and mission boundaries, partial/implausible/disagreeing readings, long ground outage/backlog, incapacitated/absent crew and cross-crew privacy. Relative inference/lease/probe durations use elapsed deadlines and monotonic time only in one epoch; stated consent/content expiries remain absolute.

Build the pure domain and agreed application boundary only. Sources: docs/tdd/E13.md sections 3.1 to 3.11, 4.3, 8, 10 and 13 (lines 89, 172, 402, 478, 903); SYSTEM 4.1/4.2/5/6.4/8.2/8.3. C2 must first publish missing repository method signatures, provider projections, task-result representation and DTO fields. Implement the designed Conversation context/lifecycle, TurnState and InvalidTurnTransition, OutputKind/FinalOutput, material snapshot checks, bounded loop decisions, validation/verification rules, insight limits and runtime transitions. Supersede legacy INV-E13-09 with SYSTEM 5.10.1 generation-safe recovery; distinguish no speculative failed-turn effects from deterministic timeout incompleteness, whose atomic binding is C4.
